ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels to 60% low-intensity black/grey pixels across the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white block on the left lobe tip; dense vertical black striations and mottling originating from the trailing edge and extending toward the base; the right lobe consists of high-frequency alternating black and white vertical bands.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jagged peaks along the length of the trailing edge; includes a significant deep concave indentation on the distal left lobe approximately 50 pixels deep; pixel amplitude of standard serrations varies between 5 to 20 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward curve on the left lobe distal tip; right lobe distal tip displays a similar convex upward trajectory before meeting the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of white high-contrast circular pixels (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of the left and right lobes; a single distinct dark circular pixel cluster (approx 15 pixel diameter) is isolated within the white field of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel vertical dark linear disruptions (rake marks) cutting through the high-intensity white regions on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major semi-circular amputation or traumatic indentation located on the distal trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'eye-like' dark circular focal point surrounded by white pixels on the mid-left lobe surface.
